How to Play

Controls

Player 1: Arrow keys move · Enter hold/release to shoot, tap to tackle · Shift sprint (double-tap to juke) · / switch player

Player 2: WASD move · Space hold/release to shoot, tap to tackle · Shift sprint (double-tap to juke) · Q switch player

Mouse only comes into play for penalty shootouts — aim with the cursor, hold Space to power the shot.

The Juke

Double-tap your sprint key to fake out a defender. For half a second afterward, any tackle against you has a real chance to simply miss. It's on a short cooldown, so time it well rather than spamming it.

Traits

Before kickoff you can give your team one special edge: Rocket Shot (harder shots from your forward), Silky Feet (faster, tighter dribbling from your midfielder), The Wall (your defense wins far more tackles), or Sweeper Keeper (extra goalkeeper reach). Look for the glow on the pitch to see who has it.

Modes

Country and Custom Team let you pick or design your kit. Tournament is a knockout bracket against the country roster. PK Practice lets you drill shooting or goalkeeping on their own, with no match attached.

Difficulty

Easy → Semi-Pro → Pro → World Class. Higher tiers move faster, tackle more often, and have sharper goalkeepers.

Good to know

Escape pauses a live match. A draw at full time goes to a penalty shootout. Halftime and full-time both show a stats breakdown for both sides.

5 v 5 SOCCER

Local 2-player: Player 1 vs Player 2. Each side moves, sprints, switches players, and kicks independently.

Paused

Player 1 — arrow keys

↑↓←→ move Enter — hold to power a kick when you have the ball, tap to tackle when you don't Shift (right) sprint — double-tap to juke past a defender / switch to teammate nearest the ball control auto-jumps to whichever Player 1 player has the ball

Player 2 — WASD

W A S D move Space — hold to power a kick when you have the ball, tap to tackle when you don't Shift (left) sprint — double-tap to juke past a defender Q switch to teammate nearest the ball control auto-jumps to whichever Player 2 player has the ball
